title.en: Hull-White one factor, exposure and CVA
title.es: Hull-White de un factor, exposicion y CVA

statement.en: EE is the positive exposure to the counterparty, ENE the bank's own, CVA a positive cost and DVA a positive benefit.
statement.es: EE es la exposicion positiva a la contraparte, ENE la propia del banco, CVA un costo positivo y DVA un beneficio positivo.

units.money: amount with its ISO 4217 currency code, USD in this case

fixed_rate_rule.value: the par yield at the swap's maturity on the curve date, rounded to 10 bp
fixed_rate_rule.label: convention

trades.floating_leg: USD floating leg on the single curve of the case
trades.label: convention

curve.source: US Treasury daily par yield curve (home.treasury.gov)

calibration_used.estimator: exact AR(1) OLS on the shortest Treasury zero rate (Brigo et al., arXiv 0812.4210, equations 55 to 57)
calibration_used.fit_to_curve: phi(t) = f(0,t) + sigma^2 (1 - exp(-a t))^2 / (2 a^2), the QuantLib 1.44 fitting parameter

measure_note.en: EE and ENE are undiscounted (Basel style) in the t-forward measure: the discounted EE of the engine divided by P(0, t), the quantity the analytic swaption identity gives and the one ORE's own profile reproduces; the expectation in the simulation's own measure differs by the convexity gap. The discounted profiles feed the CVA. The PFE is the quantile of the simulated exposure in the simulation measure. Effective EE starts from zero: the current exposure is the replacement cost of the sa_ccr block. EPE and EEPE are averages over the first year; their errors are batch errors of 20 antithetic batches.
measure_note.es: EE y ENE no estan descontados (estilo Basilea) en la medida t-forward: el EE descontado del motor dividido por P(0, t), la cantidad que da la identidad analitica de la swaption y la que reproduce el perfil de ORE; la esperanza en la medida propia de la simulacion difiere por la brecha de convexidad. Los perfiles descontados alimentan el CVA. El PFE es el cuantil de la exposicion simulada en la medida de la simulacion. El EE efectivo parte de cero: la exposicion actual es el costo de reemplazo del bloque sa_ccr. EPE y EEPE son promedios del primer ano; sus errores son errores de 20 lotes antitieticos.

cva_dva.credit_curve_label: proxy: an AAA to A market spread, a floor for lower ratings (R10)
cva_dva.negative_spread_rule: a negative HQM-minus-Treasury spread is set to zero and counted in spreads_floored_at_zero

limit.en: No official numeric example is verified; the tests rest on the invariants of dossier 01 M.1. M is the notional-weighted average maturity of the netting set (the paragraph was not re-read: UNVERIFIED).
limit.es: No hay ejemplo numerico oficial verificado; las pruebas se apoyan en los invariantes. M es el vencimiento medio ponderado por nocional del conjunto (el parrafo no se releyo: UNVERIFICADO).

backtest.calibration_rule: each initialisation date is calibrated on data up to that date only

ore_reconciliation.platform: open-source-risk-engine 1.8.17.0 wheel, CPython 3.13.14, Windows 11 AMD64, native (no WSL); 10000 samples, antithetic

tests.h0: the analytic and the simulated EE agree within the Monte Carlo error
tests.alternative: the simulated EE departs from the closed form
tests.reference: dossier 05 C.4 and the U9 research addendum R4: the Hull-White one-factor closed forms (QuantLib 1.44 hullwhite.cpp and jamshidianswaptionengine.cpp); ladder rung 2 against rung 3 (dossier 05, counterparty ladder)

tests.h0: the discounted bond prices are martingales: their mean is P(0, T)
tests.alternative: the simulated short rate does not reprice today's discount curve
tests.reference: U9 research addendum R4: the theta fit reprices today's curve, so discounted bond prices are martingales (QuantLib 1.44 hullwhite.hpp)

tests.h0: the reported EEPE equals the one recomputed from the EE profile
tests.alternative: the reported EEPE is not the effective EPE of the EE profile
tests.reference: BCBS CRE53.12 and CRE53.13, Effective EE and Effective EPE (addendum R9); dossier 05 C.1

tests.h0: the reported CVA equals the one recomputed from the discounted EE
tests.alternative: the reported CVA departs from sum PD LGD EPE
tests.reference: dossier 05 C.2, CVA = sum PD LGD EPE (ORE xva.tex, the advanced discretisation)

tests.h0: the EE profile and the CVA are converged in the number of paths

tests.reference: dossier 05, counterparty ladder: convergence in the number of paths; ORE xva.tex
